libs.note: BH-6308: bin/pipeline-health.sh pages two silent stalls. stalehold:<project>:<n> = an ai-build ticket whose newest decisive comment is a HOLD older than STALL_HOLD_MAX_H (STALL_HOLD_HOTFIX_H for a hotfix) and whose owner is not active (no live participant named in the line, no build row and no PR push inside STALL_OWNER_WINDOW_H). stalledblocker:<project>:<child>:<parent> = a hard Blocked-by on an open parent whose last merged slice is older than STALL_PARENT_MERGED_H, with no open child, no open PR and no running build. Resolved at call time with lib_env_apply stall-alerts.

knobs.note: Master switch for the stale HOLD half of bin/pipeline-health.sh's stall alerts block (stalehold:<project>:<n>). Read by stall_knob.
A comment HOLD older than this, with no active owner, pages stalehold. A value that is not a whole number of at least 1 reads as 12. Read by stall_knob.
The STALL_HOLD_MAX_H of a ticket that carries the hotfix label. A value that is not a whole number of at least 1 reads as 3. Read by stall_knob.
A HOLD owner is active when a build row for the ticket, or a push to an open PR of the ticket, is newer than this. Read by stall_knob.
Master switch for the stale-parent half of the stall alerts block (stalledblocker:<project>:<child>:<parent>). Read by stall_knob.
A hard Blocked-by parent that is still open pages once its newest merged slice is older than this and it has no open child, PR or build. Read by stall_knob.
At most this many HOLD candidate threads per project are read and judged per tick; past it one stalehold:<project>:page-cut alert names the cut. Read by stall_knob.
